title: Explore Campus
description: Tools for finding your way around campus: campus events from UW-Madison and the Wisconsin Union, and Madison Metro bus connections from a housing address to campus buildings.

blocks.title: Explore Campus
blocks.lead: What is on, and how to get there.
body: Four tools, each reading a public source and naming it. Badger Supports programs are labelled as ours; everything else keeps its own organizer and a link to its official listing.

items.title: Campus Events
lines: UW-Madison Events · Wisconsin Union · Badger Supports
items.text: Campus events in one explorer: search, filter by interest, and switch between a calendar and a list. Find Your People gathers clubs, communities and social gatherings.

items.title: Bus Routes from Home
items.text: Compare several housing addresses against the campus buildings you pick: a direct bus, one transfer, or no suitable connection. No times, schedules or predictions.

items.title: Discover Classes by Interest
lines: UW Course Search · Official course listings
items.text: Find courses by what interests you — creativity, music, languages, nature and community — from the listings in UW Course Search.

items.title: Academic Support Navigator
items.text: Answer a few questions and find the university resources that fit — tutoring, accommodations and other academic support.

blocks.title: Where the listings come from
body: Event listings come from UW-Madison Events and the Wisconsin Union event calendar; Badger Supports programs come from Badger Supports Connect. Bus routes come from Madison Metro's published route data, and addresses are placed with OpenStreetMap. Class listings come from UW Course Search, the university’s official course listings, and the Academic Support Navigator points to resources in this site’s resource library. Nothing you type into a tool here is kept.
